title: Paper accepted to ACM CCS 2026
summary: Our study of how children assess digital safety risks on Roblox was accepted to the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026), held November 15–19 in The Hague.
details: How Children Assess Digital Safety Risk in Gaming Platforms: A Case Study of Roblox — Zinan Zhang, Qiurong Song, Xinning Gui, Junnan Yu, Sunhye Bai, and Yubo Kou
